rows.label: FACT
rows.text: The machine rebooted without a clean shutdown three times in six days (10-24 09:19, 10-28 10:10, 10-28 23:12 Central). The 19:44 crash left the engine dead until 05:47Z 10-29: 13.1 hours of no tape. On 10-28 launches were logged in 17 of 24 UTC hours

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: After the 10:10 reboot the engine ran with name resolution failing: 1,798 getaddrinfo errors in hour 15Z, 2,792 an hour from 17Z to the 19:44 crash. The last launch it logged was 16:43Z, so 10-28 lost its last 7.3 hours while the heartbeat looked alive

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: The crashes NUL-filled monitor/heartbeat.json, state/shadow.json and state/excursion.json and left ten NUL or torn lines across seven journal files. common.load_json and common.read_jsonl treat an unparseable file or line as fatal, so the journal's shadow and resolve steps failed 286 ticks running and ops/readout.py crashed on journal/shadow.jsonl line 3118

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: At the first-mark fill over 10-26..10-28 the control is -0.0326 SOL a trade on 613 (PF 0.63) and every one of 25 forks is negative; the best is take +10 % at -0.0187 (PF 0.75). 10-28 to 16:43Z is the control's first positive day at that fill (+0.0188 on 154) and the counted book's first green day (about +4.4 SOL over 110 closes); one day, no candidate

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: RI-05 at the first-mark fill is -0.0275 on 261 over five days (PF 0.35); its one held-out day, 10-28, is -0.0324 on 44. The verdict window is still one partial day

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: The five real 0.01 SOL buys of 10-28 landed within 2.5 points of the first mark, 2-3 slots after the read, at a fee floor of 3.52 % a round trip. The first-mark grader is reality's grader; nothing about the fill is open at this size

rows.label: FACT
rows.text: All four 10-28 market forecasts resolved true (touches, resolved and intent 615 in 400-950; pass rate 0.242 in 0.20-0.48; Brier 0.04 each), 0 lessons owed, chain intact. The 10-29 forecasts (420-900 touches) were written assuming a full day of tape and have lost 5.8 hours of it

rows.label: INFERENCE
rows.text: The one binding stage today is the environment: the tape. Rule 3 says bits per day are the currency; the machine delivered 17 of 24 hours on 10-28 and 0 of the first 5.8 on 10-29, and silently delivered nothing for 7 hours while alive. No fork can be promoted (rule 5 needs three held-out days) and RI-05 cannot be judged (one held-out day) while the tape is intermittent. The edge finding of 10-28 is unchanged but cannot advance without tape

rows.label: INFERENCE
rows.text: The environment fails in two ways and only one of them was fixed by hand this morning: the crash damage (NUL files and lines, fixed by moving the files aside and quarantining the lines) and the engine running blind on a dead resolver (not fixed: the heartbeat does not know the feed is dead, so the guard does not restart it). A loader that treats an unparseable file as missing and a heartbeat that counts the minutes since the last launch are measurement fixes, not trading rules

rows.label: INFERENCE
rows.text: Three hard crashes in six days on a home machine are not fixed by software; the tape's uptime is bounded by the machine. The bit that reality rewards is a day of tape with no gap, and a host that stays up buys that bit at the price of a VPS the operation already runs

rows.label: INFERENCE
rows.text: One green day on the counted book (F04) at a KILL verdict is a draw, not a signal: the contract reads S1 at 40 closes and the book is 1267 closes and -47.9 SOL deep. Rule 7: the machine does not come back bigger after a green day any more than after a red one; nothing sizes up and no gate moves
